notes.title: The Barnhouse Killer Official Discord
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just launched a Discord server for the game. Nothing fancy — just a space to chat, leave feedback, report bugs, or follow along with development a bit more closely.

We’re a small team (just three of us), so being able to talk directly with people playing the game really helps. Whether you’ve already played or are just curious, feel free to join and say hey.

Join here: [url=https://discord.gg/FQU8TnVdGQ]Discord[/url]

Thanks for all the support so far,
— The Drystorm team
